title: HBO reveals first look at ‘Harry Potter’ TV series
byline: HBO revealed the first photo from its highly anticipated Harry Potter TV series.

title: Iran says US and Israel attacked vicinity of Bushehr nuclear plant
byline: Iran’s Atomic Energy Organization said that US and Israel attacked the vicinity of Iran’s Bushehr nuclear power plant on Tuesday evening, IRNA reported.

title: Showers expected in several areas after 2pm today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 pm.

title: Sri Lanka’s Central Bank keeps policy rate unchanged
byline: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) has decided to maintain the Overnight Policy Rate (OPR) at the current level of 7.75%, following its latest Monetary Policy Board meeting held yesterday (24).

title: Foreign national held with illegally imported cigarettes
byline: A foreign national has been arrested by police along with 1,300 foreign-made cigarettes that were illegally brought into the country.

title: Pharmacy owner arrested in Hatton for illegal sale of psychotropic drugs
byline: The owner of a pharmacy in Hatton town has been arrested by officers of the Hatton Divisional Anti-Corruption Unit for selling psychiatric medication to youth without valid medical prescription.

title: China’s top diplomat urges Iran toward peace talks
byline: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi urged his Iranian counterpart to “initiate peace talks as soon as possible” during a Tuesday call that Beijing said was held at the request of Tehran.

title: Social media bans and digital curfews to be trialled on UK teenagers
byline: Social media bans, digital curfews and time limits on apps are to be trialled in the homes of hundreds of UK teenagers.

title: Donald Trump sets 15-point plan to end Iran war
byline: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday the US was making progress in its efforts to negotiate an end to war with Iran, including winning an important concession from Tehran, while a source confirmed that Washington had sent Iran a 15-point settlement proposal.

title: Senate Republicans again reject effort to rein in President Trump over Iran war
byline: Republicans again rejected a resolution aimed at requiring President Donald Trump to seek congressional approval for future US military action against Iran.

title: Oil prices drop more than 5% as Donald Trump talks up Iran peace negotiations
byline: Oil prices have fallen sharply in early trade in Asia after US President Donald Trump said negotiations to end the war are in progress - a claim disputed by Iranian officials.

title: Education must go beyond knowledge dissemination to empower individuals: PM Harini
byline: The Prime Minister, Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education Dr. Harini Amarasuriya participated as the Chief Guest in the international conference on ‘Transforming TVET Systems for climate resilience and green jobs’.

title: Public urged to limit electricity use at night; No power cuts planned
byline: Minister of Energy Kumara Jayakody has requested the general public to use electricity sparingly between 6:00 p.m. and 10:00 p.m.

title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes have killed 1,072 since March 2
byline: Lebanon’s Health Ministry said Tuesday that the death toll from ongoing Israeli strikes on the country has risen to 1,072, with 2,966 people wounded since March 2, Anadolu reports.

title: Drone attack hits fuel tank at Kuwait International Airport causing fire
byline: Drones targeted a fuel tank at Kuwait International Airport, causing a fire but no ⁠casualties, Kuwait’s Civil Aviation Authority said on Wednesday.

title: Japan to assist establishment of reliable communication networks in Sri Lanka
byline: The Ambassador of Japan to Sri Lanka, Akio Isomata, signed a grant contract to provide radio equipment under the “Grant Assistance for Grassroots Human Security Projects (GGP)” scheme.

title: U.S. to send 1,000 soldiers to Middle East to be available for Iran operations
byline: Approximately 1,000 US soldiers with the Army’s 82nd Airborne Division are expecting to deploy in coming days to the Middle East, according to two sources familiar with the matter, adding to the growing military firepower in the region as the Trump administration says it is in talks with Iran to end the conflict.

title: Ex-MP Sajin Vass Gunawardena further remanded
byline: Former Member of Parliament Sajin Vass Gunawardena, who was arrested by officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC), has been further remanded.

title: Iran sends waves of missiles into Israel, dismisses Trump’s talk of negotiations as ‘fake news’
byline: Iran launched multiple waves of missiles at Israel, the Israeli military said, after U.S. President Donald Trump postponed a threat to bomb the Islamic Republic’s power grid because of what he described as productive talks with Iranian officials.

title: Airstrikes on Iraq’s Shi’ite PMF site kill 15 including Anbar commander
byline: Airstrikes targeting a site belonging to Iraq’s Shi’ite Popular Mobilization Forces in the western province of Anbar killed at least 15 fighters, including the PMF’s Anbar operations commander, and wounded 30 others, security and health sources told Reuters early on Tuesday.

title: Man arrested for hoarding and reselling 1,820L of diesel in Serunuwara
byline: An individual has been arrested in the Serunuwara area for hoarding and reselling approximately 1,820 litres of diesel without a valid license.

title: Suspect known as ‘Walpola Lala’ nabbed with ‘Ice’ and sharp weapons
byline: A 38-year-old suspect, identified as Sumithra Arachchige Lalantha Gunawardena, also known as “Walpola Lala,” has been arrested by the Mulleriyawa Police in connection with a series of housebreakings and possession of illicit goods.

title: Guidelines issued to optimise fuel use in state-owned vehicles
byline: The Commissioner-General of Essential Services, B.K. Prabhath Chandrakeerthi, has issued comprehensive guidelines aimed at optimising fuel consumption across state-owned vehicles.

title: Trump’s claim of talks with Iran might be for “markets to calm down,” former senior US official says
byline: US President Donald Trump’s claim that the US has renewed discussions with Tehran might be a move to calm markets as oil prices surge, former US Deputy Assistant Secretary of State Joel Rubin told told CNN on Tuesday.

title: ADB Chief highlights private sector investment as key to Sri Lanka’s growth
byline: The President of the Asian Development Bank (ADB), Masato Kanda, who is currently on an official visit to Sri Lanka, has underscored the critical role of private sector investment in shaping the country’s next phase of economic growth, following a roundtable discussion with private sector leaders in Colombo.

title: Online applications for 2026 A/L exam open from today
byline: Applications for the 2026 G.C.E Advanced Level (A/L) Examination will be accepted online from today (24) to April 24, 2026, the Commissioner General of Examinations has announced.

title: FM Vijitha Herath, India’s Jaishankar hold talks on impact of regional tensions
byline: India’s External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that he held a productive discussion with Sri Lanka’s Foreign Minister Vijitha Herath on the implications of the ongoing West Asia conflict.

title: Presidential Suite at Jayewardenepura Hospital opened to public
byline: The special ward at the Sri Jayewardenepura General Hospital, which had until now been reserved exclusively for the use of the Executive President, has been opened for the general public for medical treatment from today (24), the President’s Media Division stated.

title: Sri Lanka begins talks with Russian Govt. to secure fuel supplies
byline: Formal government-level talks have already begun to secure fuel supplies from Russia, according to Cabinet Spokesman Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa.

title: WMO warns climate emergency as earth hits record heat
byline: On March 23, 2026, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) delivered a stark warning: Earth’s climate has entered uncharted territory, with heat accumulating at record rates and the consequences expected to last for centuries, if not millennia.

title: Registration of Persons Dept. temporarily halts services over system failure
byline: Due to a system failure, steps have been taken to temporarily suspend public services at the Department for Registration of Person (ID Office) today (24).

title: Air India Group to operate 24 flights to West Asia today; several routes remain suspended
byline: The Air India Group said it will operate a total of 24 scheduled and non-scheduled flights to and from the West region on Tuesday, while services to several destinations remain temporarily suspended, according to an Air India press release.

title: Food security a top priority, President directs action on fertiliser stocks
byline: Ensuring food security in the country and people remains a top priority of the government, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has emphasised.

title: Court to decide on arrest warrants in SriLankan Airbus deal probe on April 2
byline: The Colombo Magistrate’s Court has announced that its order on whether to issue arrest warrants for the wife of former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of SriLankan Airlines, Kapila Chandrasena, and Shamindra Rajapaksa...

title: Jury finds that Bill Cosby sexually assaulted woman in 1972 and awards her nearly $60 million
byline: A civil jury in California found Monday that Bill Cosby was liable for drugging and sexually assaulting a woman in 1972 and awarded her $59.25 million.

title: Bahrain pushes UN-backed action for Hormuz shipping
byline: Bahrain has put forward a draft U.N. Security Council resolution that would authorise countries to use “all necessary means” - diplomatic language for force - to protect commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz, according to a text seen by Reuters on Monday.

title: Chief Inspector Linton de Silva transferred with immediate effect
byline: Chief Inspector Linton de Silva, who served as the Officer-in-Charge (OIC) of the Western Province North Crimes Division, has been transferred with immediate effect.

title: Global oil prices move back above $100 a barrel
byline: The price of Brent crude has moved back above $100 a barrel, after plunging on Monday.

title: Instagram now lets users reorder carousels after posting
byline: Instagram announced a much-anticipated update for carousel posts, with users now able to rearrange their posts within a carousel after publishing.

title: Cement prices increased
byline: The price of cement has been increased by approximately Rs. 150 to Rs. 175 by manufacturing companies.

title: GTA 6 price officially confirmed for November 2026 launch
byline: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick quietly confirms the price of Grand Theft Auto VIwhile promising one highly controversial feature will not be a part of it.

title: All services resume at Dept. of Registration of Persons
byline: All public services at the Department for Registration of Persons, which were temporarily suspended today (24) due to a system failure, have now resumed.

title: Cabinet greenlights fee-free QR payments
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval for a proposal aimed at promoting QR code-based digital payments by ensuring that no additional charges are levied on either the sender or the receiver for transactions valued below Rs. 5,000.

title: Cabinet nod to appoint expert committee to develop energy economy
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval to the proposal to appoint an expert committee to prepare a national framework to develop the energy economy.

title: Bus fares could be revised again in July based on global fuel trends
byline: It is possible for bus fares to be revised once again under the national bus fare policy scheduled to be implemented in July, Cabinet Spokesperson Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa stated.

title: Case against MP Chamara Sampath to be taken up in April
byline: The Colombo High Court has ordered that the case filed by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) against Member of Parliament Chamara Sampath Dassanayake be taken up on April 30, 2026.

title: ‘Non-hostile’ ships can transit Strait of Hormuz: Iran tells UN
byline: Iran has told the United Nations Security Council and the International Maritime Organization that “non-hostile vessels” may transit the Strait of Hormuz if they coordinate with Iranian authorities, according to a note seen by Reuters on Tuesday.

title: Netflix’s live-action Scooby-Doo series set for 2027 premiere with Paul Walter Hauser
byline: Actor Paul Walter Hauser, best known for his role in ‘Black Bird’, has bagged a pivotal role in Netflix’s live-action Scooby-Doo series.

title: No reduction in remittances despite conflict in Middle East: CBSL Governor
byline: Sri Lanka’s workers’ remittances have not seen a reduction despite the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, the Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL), Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe stated.

title: Kim Jong Un says Iran war justifies North Korea’s decision to keep its nuclear weapons
byline: North Korea’s Kim Jong Un has said that the US’ war with Iran proves his country made the right decision to keep its nuclear weapons.

title: Lamborghinis stranded in Sri Lanka as war disrupts Asia’s used-car trade – report
byline: The U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran last month plunged the Middle East into crisis, disrupted global shipping routes and spawned a series of headaches for Umar Ali Hyder Ali’s used-car business in Japan.

title: “Americans were only negotiating with themselves”: Iranian military spokesperson
byline: An Iranian military spokesperson mocked U.S. attempts at a ceasefire deal Wednesday, insisting that the Americans were only negotiating with themselves.

title: CPC confirms sufficient fuel supply until mid-May, warns against hoarding
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has revealed that fuel orders for the country currently exceed actual requirements by around 10%. However, the corporation stressed that there is no risk of a shortage if emergency stockpiling is avoided.

title: Teachers asked to explain absence from Tangalle meeting chaired by PM
byline: The Zonal Education Office of Tangalle has requested an explanation regarding the absence of teachers at a meeting held on March 15 at the Tangalle Urban Council, which was chaired by Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya.

title: Explosion reported at Valero refinery in Texas, shelter advisory issued
byline: An explosion was reported Monday at the Valero refinery in Port Arthur, Texas, according to local media.

title: 29 top drug suppliers arrested in major CID crackdown, says Dy Minister
byline: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has apprehended 29 major drug suppliers responsible for trafficking narcotics into Sri Lanka, according to the Deputy Minister of Public Security, Attorney-at-Law Sunil Watagala.

title: Iran stops Pakistan-bound ship from crossing Hormuz over lack of permission
byline: A Pakistan-bound container ship has been stopped from crossing the Strait of Hormuz by Iranian forces amid the escalating war in the Middle East.

title: 60% of Grade One entrants in Nuwara Eliya schools suffer from decayed teeth
byline: Around 60% of children admitted to grade one classes in schools across Nuwara Eliya have been found to have poor oral health, according to Maskeliya Medical Officer of Health (MOH) Dr. M. H. A. M. Irshan.

title: Australia to temporarily stop Iranians from entering the country on tourist visas
byline: Australia will temporarily stop Iranians from entering the country on tourist visas, the country’s Home Affairs minister announced Wednesday, saying temporary visitors from Iran may be “unable or unlikely to depart Australia when their visas expire.”

title: Govt reviews immediate steps to maintain continuous public service delivery
byline: The second meeting of the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed to ensure the orderly functioning of the public service was held last afternoon (24) at the Presidential Secretariat, under the patronage of Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya.

title: Iran has received US 15-point plan, Pakistan says
byline: Iran has received America’s 15-point proposal for ending the US-Israeli attack, two Pakistani officials have told the Associated Press.

title: Former SIS Chief Suresh Sallay admitted to National Hospital
byline: The former Head of the State Intelligence Service, Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay has been admitted to the Colombo National Hospital following a sudden illness.

title: Sri Lankan minds shaping the future of AI-based crisis management
byline: The escalating conflict involving Iran, the United States, and Israel represents a “global energy stress test” with profound implications for international fuel and LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) security.

title: Iran rejects US proposal and sets five conditions for ending war – report
byline: Iran has responded negatively to an American proposal aimed at ending the ongoing imposed war, insisting that it will only occur on Tehran’s own terms and timeline, a senior political-security official told Press TV on Wednesday.

title: OpenAI ends Disney partnership as it closes Sora video-making app
byline: OpenAI has shut down its artificial intelligence (AI) video-generation app Sora less than two years after its launch made headlines for creating realistic clips based on simple prompts.

title: First female Archbishop of Canterbury to be enthroned
byline: Dame Sarah Mullally is to be installed as the first ever female leader of the Church of England at Canterbury Cathedral.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and North-Western provinces and in the Anuradhapura, Mannar, Vavuniya, and Monaragala districts.

title: Iran says it fired missile at USS Abraham Lincoln carrier after warning
byline: Iran has claimed that it launched a cruise missile towards the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier, according to Iranian state television. However, there is no immediate confirmation or response from US officials.

title: Sri Lankan Ambassador honoured at Bodhi Buddhagaya Award Ceremony in Bangkok
byline: The Bodhi Buddhagaya Award Ceremony, organized by the Magadh Buddhagaya Foundation to honour distinguished individuals who have made meaningful contributions to society in line with Buddhist teachings, was held at Wat Pathum Khongkha Ratchaworawihan.

title: Suspect arrested over illegally obtaining fuel by overriding QR code
byline: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has arrested a suspect in Nittambuwa for allegedly obtaining fuel by overriding a QR code linked to a vehicle.

title: US and Iran talks could be held in Pakistan, IAEA head says
byline: The head of the International Atomic Energy Agency said there might be talks between Iran and the United States soon in Pakistan.

title: Water consumption rising amid dry weather; Public urged to consume water sparingly
byline: The Chairman of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB), Chandana Bandara, states that water consumption has increased significantly due to the prevailing dry weather.

title: Iran still reviewing US proposal despite negative initial response, senior Iranian official says
byline: Iran is still reviewing a U.S. proposal to end the war in the Gulf, despite an initial response that was negative, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday, indicating that Tehran had so far stopped short of rejecting it outright.

title: Trump’s approval rating hits record low as fuel prices surge amid Iran war
byline: President Donald Trump’s approval rating fell in recent days to its lowest point since he returned to the White House, hit by a surge in fuel prices and widespread disapproval of the war he launched on Iran, a Reuters/Ipsos poll found.
